nodes.name: IL Impregnation into MOF
nodes.procedure: IL 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium nitrate (BmimNO3) was immobilized into Cu3(BTC)2 (BTC = benzenetricarboxylate) by impregnation.
nodes.source_text: To get the target catalyst, IL 1-butyl-3-methylimidazolium nitrate (BmimNO3) was immobilized into Cu3(BTC)2 ... by impregnation

nodes.name: Electrochemical Transformation with IL
nodes.procedure: IL/Cu3(BTC)2 was subjected to electrochemical transformation using a three-electrode H-type cell separated by Nafion 117 membrane (see experimental details in the Supporting Information). After electrolysis for 15 min, the product was collected and characterized.
